description: Lists form edition changes and USCIS or Federal Register alerts published on or after a date, newest first. Use it to catch up on what changed since a last check. For one form's current edition, use check_form_edition. To find alerts by keyword, use search_alerts. Returns at most 100 form edition changes and 100 alerts per page. Pass next_cursor as cursor, with the same since, to continue until next_cursor is null. Empty lists on the first page mean nothing changed. Free, no sign-in required. Limit: 20 calls per minute per IP, then rate_limited. Not legal advice. Sources: uscis.gov form pages or dated web.archive.org captures of them, USCIS newsroom alerts, and Federal Register notices. The top-level source URL identifies the exact aggregate query, including the page cursor. Each alert and form change keeps its own source URL and content hash.

cursor.description: Opaque navigation cursor from the preceding page's next_cursor. Omit for the first page.

since.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time, e.g. "2026-08-01" or "2026-08-01T09:30:00Z"; returns changes on or after this instant. A date means midnight UTC; a date-time without an offset is UTC.

name: list_form_changes

title.example: USCIS to publish new editions of Form I-539 and Form I-765

next_cursor.description: Pass this cursor with the same since to read the next page. Null means no more changes.
